Deprecated radish names

Source: R/terradish_compat.R
radish_compatibility.Rd

terradish grew out of the radish package. The original function and class names still work so that older scripts and saved fits keep running, but they are deprecated. New code should use the terradish names in the table below.

Details

Legacy nameUse instead
radish()terradish()
radish_grid()terradish_grid()
radish_distance()terradish_distance()
radish_algorithm()terradish_algorithm()
terra_radish_scale_optim()terradish_scale_optim()
methods for class "radish" (print(), summary(), coef(), fitted(), residuals(), simulate(), anova(), logLik(), AIC(), plot())the same methods for class "terradish"; see terradish_methods and plot.terradish
conductance() for class "radish_graph"conductance() for class "terradish_graph"
class "radish_conductance_model_factory"terradish_conductance_model_factory
class "radish_measurement_model"terradish_measurement_model

The wrappers radish(), radish_grid(), radish_distance(), and radish_algorithm() pass their arguments unchanged to the replacement and signal a deprecation warning. terra_radish_scale_optim() is an alias with the same arguments as terradish_scale_optim. Objects created by terradish carry both the new and the legacy class names, so either set of methods dispatches on them.

Arguments, defaults, and returned values are documented on the replacement pages. Full compatibility with every historical radish entry point is not promised.

terradish, terradish-package
